subtitle: Carry a message, not a conquest.
briefing: The eastern villages have gone dark. Ivo carries their names and a message for the last ferryman; Nera promises to get him across the river. The Tollkeeper’s guards block the road, but this journey is about reaching the living, not conquering the valley.
hints: Move Ivo's support first. Keep him outside enemy reach until the company opens a safe path; reaching the landing matters more than clearing the map.
Arrows find little purchase in bare bones. A scout's stone sling provides ranged Impact without a skeleton's melee reply.
The river has more than one crossing.

intro.speaker: Ivo
intro.text: The eastern villages have not seen a lantern in three nights. I have their names here. Someone has to read them.

intro.speaker: Nera
intro.text: Then we get you across. Stay behind the shields. We are not here to win the river; we are here to reach the other bank.

intro.speaker: Ivo
intro.text: The ford north of the bridge is still open. And the ferryman hid his purse in the old riverside ruin, if we need supplies.

victory.speaker: Ivo
victory.text: The names are safe. But the ferryman says the dead have taken three settlements farther up the road.

victory.speaker: Nera
victory.text: We will light each one. Let the people see that the road still belongs to the living.
